steps: Open a new first-time Bell Bank business checking account between 3/1/2026 and 9/30/2026 using promo code BAXBUS500 (business must be in Crow Wing, Cass, Morrison, or Aitkin County, MN; $50 minimum deposit to open).
Keep a $5,000 minimum daily balance for 90 days and complete 10 point-of-sale debit card transactions.
Receive the $500 bonus within 5 business days after the account has been active 90 days and all qualifications are met.
